fonts.heading: Outfit
fonts.import_instructions: Add Google Fonts link for Outfit and Inter in public/index.html or import in CSS.

colors.usage: Use Primary (Forest Green) for main CTAs. Use Secondary (Terracotta) for 'Needs', urgent actions, and alerts. Use Accent (Warm Sand) for 'Haves' badges and secondary surfaces. The Off-White background provides a warm, organic, trustworthy community feel.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Flat Solid surfaces with crisp 1px borders (border-border). For sticky headers, MUST use Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/50) - NEVER fully transparent. Cards should have generous padding (p-6 or p-8) and rely on 1px borders rather than heavy box shadows.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Nested radii. Containers: rounded-2xl (1rem). Inner images/blocks: rounded-xl. Buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full).
visual_enhancers.textures: Include subtle SVG noise or a light dotted grid pattern in the hero section to evoke the 'connected local nodes' concept without looking overly technical.
visual_enhancers.animations: Hover states must include a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow increase (shadow-md). Use framer-motion for staggering list items in feeds.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing: use p-6, p-8, p-12. Prevent content collision with borders.
layouts.grid: Use Bento Grid configurations for Discover feeds and Dashboards. Mix col-span-2 and col-span-1 to create visual asymmetry and interest.
layouts.forms: Labels must be left-aligned. Inputs should have h-12 with generous padding and clear focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).

component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Specific hover transitions (transition-colors transition-transform duration-200). Avoid generic sizing.
component_instructions.cards: Listing Cards MUST clearly label 'HAVE' vs 'NEED' vs 'CAN DO' using colored pill badges. HAVE = Accent BG / Foreground Text. NEED = Secondary BG / White Text. CAN DO = Primary BG / White Text.
component_instructions.navigation: Sticky top nav MUST have backdrop blur and background color. Include Logo, Nav Links, and a prominent 'Post Listing' CTA button.
component_instructions.tabs: Override default Shadcn Tabs. Remove fixed h-9 to h-auto. Make them look like floating pills with generous padding.
component_instructions.chat: Trade detail chat: Use clear chat bubbles. User = right-aligned. Match = left-aligned.

icons.style: Use Duotone weight for a friendly, approachable aesthetic.

libraries.motion: framer-motion (for micro-interactions, layout animations, and list staggering)

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio for standard text. Never place grey text on a grey background.
accessibility.focus: Always include high-contrast focus rings on interactive elements.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case (e.g., 'submit-trade-button', 'listing-item-card').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Do not apply 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Do not center align the app container in CSS (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly BANNED).
Use modern pill-shaped or rounded-xl buttons with interaction animations.
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💭, etc) for icons. Rely on Phosphor Icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. p-6 or p-8 minimum for card padding.
Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Add glass-morphism to headers (backdrop-blur-xl) but NEVER fully transparent.
NEVER use placeholder URLs. Use the provided Unsplash images.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Use sonner for toasts. Do not build a custom HTML toast from scratch.
Prioritize Shadcn UI primitives over custom HTML select/input.
Ensure 'Connected local nodes' visual concept is respected by using a light dotted or faint mesh background pattern in the hero/landing page.
Note: Ensure to write component logic in standard .js/.jsx extensions since this project does not use TypeScript by default.
